title: Frontiers: Moment Marketing: Measuring Dynamics in Cross-Channel Ad Effectiveness
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Hourly time-series regressions of search volume, impressions and clicks on log TV advertising spend (continuous) of the focal brand, a competitor and others, with daypart, week and day-of-week dummies, plus mediation analysis.
design_notes: data_code/main.R: lm(Y ~ 0 + as.factor(dayparts) + as.factor(week) + as.factor(dayofweek) + f_TV + c1_TV + other_TV + LTV stocks ...) for search, impressions, organic and paid clicks (Sections 3 and 4.1). Single brand time series, continuous treatment.
data_files_note: readme.txt: under NDA 'we provide a simulated data set'; original scales not revealed.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
